fields.value: XYZ coordinate files of structures from thesis " Activation mechanisms in homogeneous iron catalysis"

dsDescriptionValue.value: XYZ files for the structures used in the thesis " Activation mechanisms in homogeneous iron catalysis". They are given with titles referencing the chapters they are in. XYZ can be opened and visualized using standard quantum chemistry software, such as avogadro or pymol.
